description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2014 World Championships with a sword-and-shield plan: Virizion-EX shields the team from Special Conditions, and Genesect-EX with a G Booster can Knock Out nearly any Pokémon in one attack, after its Ability pulls one of the opponent's Benched Pokémon forward. The 2014 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., from 15 to 17 August 2014.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2014 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
